nodes.description: External function that iterates over recipients and calls token.transferFrom(msg.sender, recipients[i], values[i]*10**18) for each entry.
IERC20 token contract address supplied by the caller; the target of the external transferFrom call.
Fixed-size array of three recipient addresses receiving the dispersed tokens.
Fixed-size array of three amounts, each multiplied by 10**18 before being transferred.
Loop counter indexing the recipients and values arrays during the dispersal loop.
Caller address used as the `from` argument of transferFrom, so the caller must have approved this contract.
External call into an arbitrary caller-supplied IERC20 contract for each recipient inside the loop, with the result enforced by require.

edges.reason: The token parameter determines which contract is invoked by the external transferFrom call.
Each recipients[i] element is passed as the `to` argument of transferFrom.
Each values[i]*10**18 amount is passed as the value argument of transferFrom.
msg.sender is passed as the `from` argument of transferFrom, tying the transfer to the untrusted caller.
The loop index i selects the array elements that feed the external transferFrom call on each iteration.
Execution of the function body enters the external token.transferFrom call inside the loop.

normalization_plan.reason: The token parameter exists only to select the target contract of the token.transferFrom external call, so it is normalized into that unsafe_operation node.
The recipients parameter is consumed solely as the `to` argument of token.transferFrom, so it is normalized into that unsafe_operation node.
The values parameter is consumed solely as the amount argument of token.transferFrom, so it is normalized into that unsafe_operation node.
The loop counter i is a purely local iteration variable of disperseTokenSimple and carries no independent semantics, so it is normalized into the enclosing function node.
